Title: Public Preview: Online Migration for MongoDB in Azure Data Studio

Body.Content:
We’re thrilled to announce online migration, a significant enhancement to the MongoDB migration extension, in Azure Data Studio. With online migration, you can now transfer your MongoDB databases while your applications continue to run. No more sleepless nights worrying about service interruptions or lengthy maintenance windows. Our robust intuitive interface provides real-time progress updates, so you’re always in the loop.

Learn more.
